compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: After the people are baptized, Jesus is baptized and prays. Heaven opens, the Spirit descends in bodily form, and the voice names the beloved Son.
observations.label: Prayer, Spirit, and the voice mark Luke’s baptism scene

observations.body: The passage presents Baptism and prayer as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Baptism and prayer

observations.body: The passage places The voice addresses the beloved Son beside Baptism and prayer.
observations.label: The voice addresses the beloved Son

payload.posture: Read Luke 3:21–22 as one movement in the temptation of Jesus, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states after the people are baptized, Jesus is baptized and prays. Heaven opens, the Spirit descends in bodily form, and the voice names the beloved Son. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the temptation of Jesus.
payload.title: Prayer, Spirit, and the voice mark Luke’s baptism scene
